styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids-sportswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, cherry-blossom pink #F7D3DC, mist blue #DDEBFA, klein blue accent #3E7BDB and soft violet #9B8FD9 for gradient panels, charcoal text #2D2D2D; bright soft studio lighting with a gentle directional front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern rounded geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean kids sneaker photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale with balanced natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张爆款童鞋详情长图切片提炼。源集合混有白色网面低帮款特写与粉底网球场景儿童魔术贴高帮款，主产品判定为出现于 5/9 切片且占据首图的儿童加绒高帮魔术贴运动鞋（白底彩条、生胶底、绒里保暖）。已剥离源身份元素：鞋身品牌印字与货号、鞋底第三方品牌 logo、页首 LOGO 占位、原文案（含英文口号与歌词式文案行）、二维码会员角标、全部原印中英文文案。产品一律以 {product} 注入，文案以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 短句槽位重建由商家回填；缺失资质证据不虚构，信任镜以可见做工与触感细节呈现。
